gaps.sentence: An accident held ___ the traffic for two hours.
I came ___ an old letter while clearing the attic.
We're trying to get rid ___ these old boxes.
gaps.explanation: get rid OF something = remove it.

gaps.sentence: Police are looking ___ the cause of the crash.
She cheered ___ when she heard the news.
gaps.explanation: cheer up = become happier (also transitive: cheer somebody up).

gaps.sentence: The old cinema was knocked ___ to build a car park.
gaps.explanation: knock down = demolish a building; hit with a vehicle.

gaps.sentence: The band broke ___ in the middle of the song.
Do come round ___ dinner next week.
gaps.explanation: come round = visit; come round FOR dinner/TO our place.
